content.question: What does batch normalization do for each mini-batch during training?
options: Normalizes each feature map of every sample independently.
Divides the channels into groups and normalizes within each group.
Computes statistics per sample, across its features.
Computes the mean and variance of the activations across the mini-batch and scales them to roughly zero mean and unit variance.
content.answer: Computes the mean and variance of the activations across the mini-batch and scales them to roughly zero mean and unit variance.
